meta.title: Foyer
meta.description: Set rules for your AI assistants so they don’t spend or book without agreement.

home.title: Keep your AI assistants from fighting over your money.
home.lead: One bot books travel. Another watches the budget. They both act in your name, but they want different things. You write the rules. Foyer checks each request against those rules before anything is paid or booked.
